concept.title: “For” and “only for” are different
concept.shortdesc: Every statement about who a service is for is marked as eligibility, intended audience or exclusion.

conbody.p: Every statement about who a service is for is marked as one of three things.

dlentry.dd: Only these people may use it.
It is aimed at these people, but open to others.
It is not for these people.

conbody.p: Confusing the first two is the commonest fault in directories. It either hides services from people who could use them, or sends people to services that will turn them away.
